goal: Add and end-to-end verify safe repo-local RunPod GPU browser testing infrastructure for Codex and Claude Code.
observations: Worktree was clean at task start on codex/wave1-build-experiment.
The project already uses Node >=20, Playwright 1.56.1 under tools/, and deterministic SwiftShader browser helpers; hardware-GPU runs must use a separate launch path.
Existing reports explicitly defer native visual captures and Tier-H performance evidence because the local container uses SwiftShader.
RunPod rejected the configured 50-character rpa_ API credential with HTTP 401 through both documented REST Bearer and GraphQL api_key authentication. No Pod was created and no spend occurred.

Local self-tests pass 6/6: allowlist/price/capacity selection, idempotent deletion, ambiguous-create no-retry, orphan cleanup scope, dirty-worktree snapshot fidelity, and ephemeral SSH key generation.
A fail-closed one-minute CLI run recorded the authentication failure, created no Pod, and correctly recorded cleanup as unnecessary.
blockers: Live end-to-end verification requires the Codespace to receive a valid RUNPOD_API_KEY with GPU/template read and Pod create/read/delete permissions. The owner has been given the exact required change.
next_step: Complete adversarial code review and aggregate local gates; then, when the replacement key is visible, run doctor/list and a real minimal-cost smoke through verified termination.
